# Runze Says: Dao Ke Dao — One Measuring Stick, Nine Re-read Classics

> Hub: <https://q1z2q3-debug.github.io/runze-daokedao/>

The Daodejing, the Yizhuan, the Heart Sutra, the Zhuangzi, the Diamond Sutra, the Platform Sutra — two thousand years of commentators, each speaking past the others. This series does one thing only: take each key character back to the moment it was coined, then watch how it grows into a sentence, into a sutra. A character-study volume on oracle bone script and two primer readers (Qianziwen, Sanzi Jing) sit behind the main six, under the same name "Dao Ke Dao".

The author is Runze (Dr. Runze). The series name comes from "Dao ke dao, fei chang dao": whatever Dao is spoken, it is no longer the constant Dao. So every reading here is a provisional designation — usable, transmissible, checkable, but not to be held as the thing itself. Each book keeps its base text, variant readings, and revision trail visible, so a reader can see how this particular reading was arrived at.

## One shared measuring stick

The six classics differ in form; underneath runs one sentence in three layers:

**A is spoken** (provisionally set up; its conditioned working is acknowledged) → **yet not A** (grasping is released; no fixed self-nature is asserted) → **named A** (provisional name, the middle way; used without clinging).

The three layers are not three steps of reasoning. They are three faces of the same sentence:

- The Daodejing uses it to handle 无 (wu) and 有 (you) as two lenses, not two objects.
- The Yizhuan uses it to distinguish the human-made 合 (combining, categorizing) from the heavenly 之和 (harmony, differences each rightly placed).
- The Heart Sutra uses it to dismantle the five skandhas and state emptiness, and to draw the line between prajna insight and Tiantai samatha-vipashyana.
- The Zhuangzi uses it to separate 合 (human classification, naming, institution) from 和 (differences that hold their place without harming one another).
- The Diamond Sutra hands this stick down section by section. "Yet not" is not negation; it is non-grasping. Reading it as "really there is no such thing" falls into annihilationism.
- The Platform Sutra gathers it back into the mind: non-abiding is the body, self-nature is the function. Self-nature is not an independent, permanent entity; it is the name prajna emptiness bears on the side of living beings.

Together the six run to about 1.88 million characters. Each has a DOI archive, a web reading edition, and an offline Android package that works without a network.

## Character study and primers

Outside the six, three more volumes sit under the same "Dao Ke Dao" name, each its own repository:

- **Oracle bone script (Jiaguwen)**: 77 fascicles by category, character by character; each entry keeps the glyph, etymology, detailed gloss, parallel inscription, one world, one insight. [Read](https://q1z2q3-debug.github.io/daokedao-jiaguwen/)
- **Thousand-Character Classic (Qianziwen)**: 33 lessons for parent-child reading; an appendix glosses 120 common oracle bone characters, cross-referenced with the Jiaguwen volume. [Read](https://q1z2q3-debug.github.io/daokedao-qianziwen/)
- **Three-Character Classic (Sanzi Jing)**: 201 lessons, one page each; the received text is reordered into three strands — forming a person, knowing the world, encouraging study — across twelve stages. [Read](https://q1z2q3-debug.github.io/daokedao-sanzijing/)

## Four standing constraints

| Constraint | Practice |
|---|---|
| Base text first | Wang Bi, Mawangdui A and B, Zhu Xi, and the received text are kept side by side where they differ; where the reading cannot be settled, the body follows one edition and the note records the other and its weight. |
| Etymology before doctrine | A key character returns to its pre-Qin glyph and usage before the chapter's point is argued; no thesis first, evidence afterward. |
| No fortune-telling verdicts | The Yizhuan marks timing and position, not "lucky / unlucky"; the Heart Sutra does not present emptiness as a state to attain. |
| Trail left for checking | Every book keeps its revision record, version number, and freeze list; what was changed and why can be traced. |

## Offline reading and citation

Seven books ship an Android reader: zero permissions, readable offline, fonts bundled — Daodejing, Yizhuan, Heart Sutra, Zhuangzi, Diamond Sutra, Platform Sutra, Sanzi Jing. Scan a code or follow the link from the [hub download area](https://q1z2q3-debug.github.io/runze-daokedao/#apk). The Qianziwen and Jiaguwen have no package yet; the web edition reads directly.

The six classics each carry a DOI archive traceable by version. The full catalog, repository links, and machine-readable index are on the [hub homepage](https://q1z2q3-debug.github.io/runze-daokedao/) and the [all-books list](https://github.com/q1z2q3-debug/runze-daokedao/blob/main/ALL-BOOKS.md).
